summary: Second retest of Admin Wallet Mobile v2 drill-down (owner_id 9a455f27… — Aïda Client) after both HIGH fixes in /app/frontend/app/admin/wallet/[ownerId].tsx. ALL 5 SCENARIOS PASS: (1) Plancher -5 000 → after reload InfoRow reads 'Plancher (min balance) -5 000 F' (wallet v81); the amt<=0 guard now correctly skips for action==='min_balance'.
